entities.summary: Samuel Bejan Tata was a Chinese photographer and photojournalist of Parsi descent. Tata grew up in Shanghai, where he learned the basics of photography from several mentors, including Lang Jingshan and Liu Xucang. Due to political unrest, he mostly confined himself in his early career to portraiture in the tradition of pictorialism.
